business_rules.primary_source: 主证据选择完整原文句及必要段落，保留形状、边缘、密度/信号、强化、组织结构等实际视觉表现和直接影像测量；一般形态定义允许，无具体病例或配图也可。不得重新组织、改写或翻译原文；非连续、跨主体或跨病例的片段各有出处并显式分隔，不能拼成貌似完整连续原句。保留必要主体、否定、不确定性、条件、指代、数值及单位，患者信息可作必要语境。

current_reliability_repair.scope: 工程修复；真实216历史结果不追改，默认三输入方案/原文范围/严格schema不变。

repairs.change: Keep the original strict rejection. Allow at most2 distinct safe correction opportunities in the same bound session and existing metered budget; an exact repeated invalid call stops. Unknown tools, identity/path overrides, source-bound failures and all unclassified errors stop. Unsafe turns block other known tool calls before writes. No argument is normalized or silently rewritten.
repairs.boundary: Every SDK tool start records original argument SHA/length/property names and exact safe selector arrays; tool ends record result SHA/length and classified error. Arbitrary source/SDK strings, credentials and complete wire bodies are not logged.

repairs.change: An explicit missing/out-of-run target is rejected and never converted to insert. A feature revision must keep exact primary anchors and quote, no known subject/modality/phase/condition/assertion conflict, same origin and no changed existing citations; it is appended as an unapproved proposal under the old identity. All version/context/Figure differences remain. Unsafe revisions reject. Exact proposal replay is idempotent. Fingerprints also retain supporting table differences.
repairs.boundary: This does not deduplicate distinct subjects, citations, origins, anchors or merely similar text. The old active candidate remains; no claim that all duplicate cases are solved.

repairs.change: Keep a128-original-line LRU transport window, exact current candidate packets, complete source units and explicit missing-unit reread hints. Superseded raw-read/context copies become explicit receipts; no original line or candidate field is sliced. Historical actual-read inventory stays separate, evicted lines must be explicitly reread to support updates. Source text/model capacity and16-response limits are not raised. One summary submission atomically commits its evidence operations or rolls them all back; validation diagnostics remain explicitly outside that rollback. A valid saved submission with insufficient completion coverage returns complete:false, blockers, current_versions and saved_update receipts. Current candidate versions must be seen, and independent review/audits remain required when selected.
repairs.boundary: The actual old15 calls had no complete per-call arrays/wire bodies; this deterministic local reproduction does not prove they all read identical arguments. New large candidate packets or genuinely large necessary source remain subject to the existing128k cap; no general guarantee of summary completion or live cost improvement.

checks.provider_calls: All new runtime checks use synthetic loopback Responses SSE or direct read-only tools. New AGICTO requests0.

unverified: No new real provider output or post-fix API cost/time effect
No medical relevance/quality review of new outputs
No formal method winner, default selection, full recall or S4/S5 quality pass
No automatic healing of all semantic conflicts or sentence/caption ambiguities
